integrity.method: analytic gamma-moment differentiation and strict digamma monotonicity
integrity.validation: same-model review plus exact finite arithmetic and direct beta quadrature; independent validation not performed

scientific_limitations: Finite Dirichlet vectors with at least two strictly positive parameters only
Exact covariance only; not a full dependence ordering
Older generic moment identities may imply the mixed moment implicitly; absence of all historical coverage is not certified
Finite computer checks do not establish the universal all-real proof
title: Universal negative Shannon–Simpson concentration covariance under heterogeneous Dirichlet laws
